items.title: Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1959-01-02
items.q: Also John and Sensei used to come home.

ctx.x: Uh, what was the first music you ever heard? Can you remember? It would be around home no doubt. Yes Bill. Did your father ever practice at home or?
Oh yes, yes and yeah. Bill they practiced at home most ever did. Also John and Sensei used to come home.
When your father would practice, did he practice sometime by himself on new pieces or was it usually somebody else came in and played with him?
